thread.title: Nasdaq Leads Major Stock Market Indexes Lower Ending Shortened Week on Painful Note

title: Nasdaq Leads Major Stock Market Indexes Lower Ending Shortened Week on Painful Note
text:
Nasdaq Leads Major Stock Market Indexes Lower Ending Shortened Week on Painful Note December 07, 2018, 03:56:04 PM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo
Stocks were indicated to close sharply lower and end the shortened trading week with a thud as the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 were poised to post a three-session losing streak.
The Dow and S&P 500 were each set to fall more than 2% Friday as concerns over the outcome of trade talks between China and the US set in and helped push the market lower. The Nasdaq Composite Index suffered steeper losses, tumbling about 3% late in the session, weighed down by losses in technology giants such as Microsoft ( MSFT ), Apple ( AAPL ) and Alphabet ( GOOG ).
